1. **#6673** (merged 2026-10-12, commit `085d24c`): adds `RepeatedSlashFilter.doFilterInternal`, a new class's override. `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/RepeatedSlashFilter.java:50`
2. **#6680** (merged 2026-10-13, commit `2d32d20`): adds `TrailingSlashFilter.doFilterInternal`, which is in a new file added by this commit. `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/TrailingSlashFilter.java:54`
3. **#6544** (merged 2026-10-08, commit `a69b14a`): adds `OpenmrsSecurityContextFilter.doFilterInternal` in a new file, and deletes `OpenmrsFilter.java`, which removed its `doFilterInternal` method and `@see` line. `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/security/OpenmrsSecurityContextFilter.java:50`
4. **#6505** (merged 2026-08-26, commit `1d0fb13`): rewrites the `GZIPFilter.doFilterInternal` signature, removing the old line and adding a new one. `openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/GZIPFilter.java:48`
